name: Bruno Moya
headline: Software Developer & Glassear Founder
description: Software developer based in Barcelona. Creator of Glassear and CTO at TopBrokers.io, working across web applications, backend systems, infrastructure and mixed reality.

experience.summary: Hands-on technical ownership of production software and infrastructure, from architecture and implementation to deployment, validation and operations.
highlights: Architect and build backend systems, APIs, automation platforms and distributed services.
Operate PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, networking, backups, monitoring and cloud/on-premise infrastructure.
Design fleet and device management, browser/device automation and communication workflow systems.
Lead infrastructure migrations and optimization work focused on reliability and cost efficiency.
Make architecture decisions and deliver production systems as both technical leader and hands-on engineer.

experience.summary: Founded Glassear to build accessible mixed-reality glasses, working across custom hardware, computer vision, Unity and web applications.
highlights: Build Glassear Studio, a platform that uses AI to turn natural-language instructions into interactive XR applications.
Designed AI Planner, Intent Graph, agent/tool and MCP integrations, structured scene modifications and runtime synchronization.
Combine deterministic execution and validation with LLM reasoning across a Unity runtime and web platform.
Develop software and hardware for XR, including computer vision, Android device protocols and custom headset integrations.
Own product direction, architecture and implementation across TypeScript, React, Node.js, Unity, Python and PostgreSQL-based systems.

experience.summary: Built the Hess Test web application for psychological evaluation in recruitment, with a React interface and a WordPress/PHP backend.
highlights: Implemented data storage, user management and automated email delivery.
Used processing queues to run reliably within shared-hosting constraints and supported multiple devices and browsers.

experience.summary: Supported FECAMM, a rare-disease non-profit, in bringing accessible games to the Patient73 platform.
highlights: Helped organize month-long game jams with UAB, UPC and participating hospitals.

experience.summary: Built and optimized AR applications and interfaces using ManoMotion hand tracking, Unity and computer-vision techniques.
Developed an Android application in Java for pose, face and object tracking during an internship at the Computer Vision Center.

projects.name: JobAgent
projects.title: JobAgent - Autonomous AI Job Search & Application System
projects.outcome: I use JobAgent to manage my own job search.
projects.problem: Job discovery and application management combine semantic judgment with workflows that must remain accurate, traceable and under candidate control.
projects.description: An autonomous, agentic job-search platform for role discovery, semantic matching, job analysis, CV tailoring and controlled browser-assisted applications.
projects.architecture: FastAPI and Celery services coordinate PostgreSQL-backed workflows with a React/TypeScript interface and Docker deployment. The application lifecycle is represented as an explicit state machine with observability and audit trails.
projects.aiComponent: LLMs analyze role fit, tailor CV content and support agent workflows through an OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini abstraction. Reactive Resume is integrated through REST and MCP.
projects.deterministicComponent: Playwright automation, approval gates, the Candidate Answer Vault, application state transitions and anti-hallucination safeguards keep actions repeatable and reviewable.
projects.principle: LLMs are used where semantic reasoning is useful; deterministic software is used where reliability, integrity and repeatability matter.

projects.name: TalentGapAnalyzer
projects.title: TalentGapAnalyzer - AI Workforce Intelligence
projects.problem: Organizations need a defensible way to understand skill gaps, role compatibility and workforce development opportunities.
projects.description: AI-powered workforce intelligence and talent gap analysis platform built as a team project at UAB The Hack 2025.
projects.architecture: A Python/FastAPI analysis backend uses Pandas and Scikit-learn, with a React interface, provider fallback, caching and cost/token tracking.
projects.aiComponent: OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini generate career recommendations, development plans, organizational insights and explainable narratives.
projects.deterministicComponent: Structured compatibility analysis, caching, cost tracking, bias checks, guardrails and audit data constrain and explain generated output.
projects.principle: Model-generated recommendations are paired with measurable analysis, safeguards and explainability.

projects.name: Glassear Studio
projects.title: Glassear Studio - Natural Language to Interactive XR
projects.outcome: An AI-native platform for building and modifying interactive XR applications across a web authoring environment and Unity runtime.
projects.problem: Creating interactive XR applications normally requires specialized tooling and manual coordination between authoring systems and runtime state.
projects.description: Glassear Studio translates natural-language intent into structured, synchronized changes to interactive XR applications.
projects.architecture: An AI Planner and Intent Graph coordinate tool-based operations, MCP integrations, structured scene patches and runtime synchronization between a TypeScript/React/Node.js web platform and Unity.
projects.aiComponent: LLMs interpret intent and plan tool calls within explicit system constraints.
projects.deterministicComponent: Typed operations, validation, reconciliation and runtime acknowledgements control how planned changes become scene state.
projects.principle: Reasoning proposes changes; deterministic contracts validate, apply and synchronize them.
